about: Faces of the members of a shetach's Vaad Hashluchim, for its card (owner, Nov 5: "Where there's a Vaad ... all their faces somehow arranged ... not overlapping ... nicely done"; "if you have better pics of anshei havaad ... use them ... and as usual do proper editing"). 160x160 JPEG in web/img/vaad/<shetach id>-<surname>.jpg, retouched by scripts/head-photos/retouch.py --keep; 'crop' as in head-photos.json (on the 'tile' of a collage where one is given). 'match': sure (his own center's photo or a caption), likely (looks like a captioned photo of him), guess (by elimination). Florida's are from each one's own photo where found, else from anash.org's collage of the vaad elected Feb 2023 (not in the article's name order). 'role' as in data/shetachim.json's vaadMembers (the alternate stays out of the honeycomb). Not on the live page yet. The UK's Hanholo (Nov 5, later session; owner: "pls do uk hanholo next"): its twelve living members, each from a photo of him alone; Rabbi Isaac Hirsh (Yitzchok 'Icky') Sufrin, on the Hanholo's list, passed away 3 Feb 2026 (anash.org; Companies House lists him, born Feb 1940, as a director of Lubavitch (UK) Ltd).
